categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production and sales of high-efficiency heat exchangers. Main products include high-efficiency shell-and-tube heat exchangers, coaxial tube-and-shell heat exchangers, plate heat exchangers, falling film heat exchangers, evaporative condensers, liquid cooling radiators and distributors. These products are widely applied in heating, hot water supply, refrigeration, data centers, and industrial/agricultural production fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core proprietary technologies in heat exchanger product design, production processes, and testing analysis. Key technologies include: multi-head spiral tube structures with patent designs, surface-enhanced heat transfer technology, innovative distributor liquid distribution technology, integrated structure combining distributors/collectors with heat exchangers, U-bend processing and welding technology, and specialized evaporative condenser designs. The company employs standardized and modular design approaches enabling efficient batch production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major domestic manufacturers including Haier, Midea, Gree, and Tian Jia, as well as international brands such as Carrier, York, Trane, Daikin, Hitachi, and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. Primary end markets include commercial air conditioning systems, heat pump systems for heating and hot water, refrigeration systems, data center cooling, and industrial thermal applications. The company maintains long-term stable partnerships with industry-leading customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Anji County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has established production facilities in Anji and Xinchang, Zhejiang. Domestic sales account for 99.63% of revenue, with minimal international operations (0.37% of revenue). The company focuses on the Chinese market while maintaining some export activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream/downstream segment of the supply chain as a component manufacturer. It produces heat exchangers and related components that are integrated into larger HVAC and refrigeration systems by original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). The company sources raw materials (copper, aluminum, steel) from suppliers and sells finished products directly to major appliance and equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes product innovation and technological advancement with R&D investment of 4.72% of revenue. Strategic initiatives include: developing high-temperature heat exchangers for expanded applications, optimizing distributor designs for cost reduction, developing R290 refrigerant-compatible products, creating high-temperature heat water exchangers for industrial applications, improving liquid cooling radiators for data centers, and developing complex heat exchange solutions. The company collaborates with universities including Xi'an Jiaotong and Shanghai Jiaotong on advanced research.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of heat exchanger products and components to OEM customers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also generates minor revenue from distributor/reseller channels (3.81% of revenue). Revenue model is transaction-based product sales rather than recurring or subscription-based.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic heat exchanger manufacturer with competitive advantages in product quality, technology innovation, and customer relationships. Major competitors include other specialized heat exchanger manufacturers and component suppliers serving the HVAC industry. The company holds advantageous market positions in shell-and-tube and coaxial tube-and-shell heat exchanger segments. It has been recognized as an excellent zero-component supplier by the China Energy Conservation Association Heat Pump Committee for multiple consecutive years.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 525.1 million yuan, down 7.4% from 567.1 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 59.4 million yuan in 2024, down 41.25% from 101.2 million yuan in 2023. The company has total assets of 1.52 billion yuan and shareholders' equity of 1.33 billion yuan as of end-2024. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in May 2023, raising 88.78 million yuan in net proceeds for capacity expansion and R&D initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-efficiency, reliable heat exchanger solutions with superior thermal performance and durability. Key differentiators include: proprietary multi-head spiral tube technology enabling higher heat transfer efficiency, innovative distributor designs ensuring uniform refrigerant distribution, integrated manufacturing reducing assembly complexity, compatibility with new environmentally-friendly refrigerants (R290, R32), modular designs enabling customization, and comprehensive quality certifications (ISO9001, UL, PED, ASME). The company positions itself as a technology leader providing cost-effective solutions that help customers improve product efficiency and meet environmental regulations.
